title: Sophie Adelman: 'Incorruptible by Eric Ries is my business book of the year'
summary: Adelman co-founded Multiverse and OneGarden and sits on boards. She tells founders and chief executives to read it for the governance structures, and sends them to an independent bookshop.
attribution_title: Co-Founder, Multiverse and OneGarden; Board Member
blockquote: Incorruptible by Eric Ries is my business book of the year.
